title: Pica CI job
description: One package's fetch-and-build declaration, consumed by .github/scripts/fetch_assets.py and the release workflow.

mgr.description: Backend this job builds for. Assets land in pkgs/<mgr>/, so it must match the manifest's targets.

id.description: Package directory name under src/<mgr>/. Suffixes like @immortalwrt are allowed for variants.

enabled.description: Set false to skip this package without deleting it.

manifest.description: Path to the source manifest, e.g. src/opkg/openclash/manifest. The manifest declares targets; this file must not.

provider.description: github reads a release; http_template expands url_template with {arch}/{version}/{platform}; tarball downloads an archive and unpacks it into the package's root/.

repo.description: owner/name. Required when provider is github.

arch_url_templates.description: Per-architecture URL templates, read only by the http_template provider. When an arch has an entry, those templates replace url_template/url_templates for that arch, so one architecture can fetch a different version without that URL being downloaded into every other architecture's directory. Arches without an entry keep the common list. Keys are build.matrix arch values.

strip_components.description: How many leading path components to drop while unpacking a tarball. A release archive usually wraps everything in one directory tied to the release (`fastfetch-musl-amd64/usr/bin/...`); leaving that wrapper in would put the files at the wrong depth, so the binary would not land where the manifest says it is. Read only by the tarball provider.

include.description: Paths to keep when unpacking a tarball; a path under one of these prefixes is written and anything else in the archive is skipped. A full upstream archive also carries shell completions and man pages that a router has no use for. Read only by the tarball provider.

dest_subdir.description: Optional subdirectory of root/ to unpack into. Empty, the usual case, puts the files straight into root/, which is what a `pica` artifact wants: root/ is deployed as it stands, so a per-architecture directory there would reach the device as a directory at the filesystem root.

rename.description: Name to give a download that is not an archive. A release of one bare binary is a single file whose name is the upstream's (`cloudflared-linux-amd64`), and the device wants it where the manifest says (`cloudflared`); this is what puts it there. Read only by the tarball provider, and ignored for an archive, whose members keep the names they had inside it.

arch_map.description: Renames each matrix architecture for the URL, for a source that names them its own way — a Go project calls x86_64 `amd64` and aarch64 `arm64`. An architecture not listed here is substituted as it stands. Read only by the tarball provider.

include_dirs.description: Optional. The package layout these are the only directories pica-pack reads.

role.description: What the asset contributes to the manifest.

regex.description: Matched against the upstream asset filename.

inner_regex.description: For zip assets: the member to extract.

required.description: Fail the job when no asset matches.

capture_to.description: Maps a named regex group to platform or arch.
